notes.title: 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Thanks again for all your awesome feedback and suggestions in the forums. I am happy to share another update for [b][i]Reflex Unit : Strike Ops[/i][/b] with the follows improvements and fixes!

[b]Current version 1.0.6[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Gamepad Aiming has added stickyness.[/p][/*][*][p]In Co-op mode, dead players with no vehicles remaning now spectate until the end of the game and can complete the stage with the other players.[/p][/*][*][p]Co-op players are now visible on the mini-map.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the speed of ground alignment to reduce crashes with terrain and bridges.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved render stuttering issue encountered by some players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with co-op syncing of boss at end of first stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with co-op syncing of landing craft on first stage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed animation jittering when enemy aircraft are destroyed and fall from the sky. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Please continue to share any issues or improvment suggestions you have for the game in the discussion forum and I will do my best to follow up with them.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Coming Soon:[/b] A new [b]Free DLC Epilogue stage[/b] that wraps up the story after the last campaign mission. This will be available in the coming weeks, stay tuned for more news soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/778646cd8bf14217e9fce334333a930d702c8444.gif"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Thanks for playing![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Alex[/p][p align="start"]Robosaru Games[/p]

notes.title: Post Release Update
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a few weeks since the launch of [b][i]Reflex Unit : Strike Ops[/i][/b] and I wanted to share an update on the fixes and improvements that have been rolled out since then based on your valuable feedback. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Current version 1.0.5[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Aim Assist Option (Gameplay Menu).[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad Analog Stick can control aim distant (when Aim Assist is Off).[/p][/*][*][p]Mouse aiming improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Aim Dots can be disabled/enabled (Video Menu).[/p][/*][*][p]Music, VO and Sound FX volume level controls are now more adjustable.[/p][/*][*][p]DirectX 11 is now available as an optional render engine in Windows with support for Exclusive Full Screen mode (which [i]may[/i] give better performance than the default Vulkan engine). [/p][p]To enable DirectX 11, add the following to the Launch Options in Properies > General:[/p][p][b]-force-d3d11[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]CO-OP Mode networking fixes for objectives across clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Various Japanese Language fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]On some systems that do not support Vulkan the game would not start (DX11 added as fallback render engine).[/p][/*][*][p]Game would sometimes unpause when inside settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Trucks would sometimes collide.[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements would sometimes trigger incorrectly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please continue to share any issues or improvment suggestions you have for the game in the discussion forum and I will do my best to follow up with them.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing![/p][p][/p][p]Alex[/p][p]Robosaru Games[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Reflex Unit: Strike Ops Demo - May 2025 Update
notes.content:
We’re excited to roll out a fresh update for the Reflex Unit: Strike Ops demo, with some new features and enhancements:

[list]
[*][b]More Destruction![/b] Now even more of the NEOTECH facilities can be destroyed, with more bombastic explosions. Looks out for pickups in the rubble!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/ad41cd4363c31ec3d0761550041e197c3e6b099a.gif[/img]

[*][b]Improved Flight Model![/b] Your helicopters now control more realistically with physics based intertia. The Scout Chopper is quick and nimble, the Cargo Chopper is heavy and more challenging to control and the Rescue Chopper is a good all rounder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/1e01b4b7cca55c70037eb410d2e5b9feaeb2856c.gif[/img]

[*][b]Air Drops![/b] You can now call in Ammo, Armor and Fuel air drops in the field for yourself, or you and your friends to use when playing co-op mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/c549c793199f091033cc4ed262499f9a56b39182.gif[/img]
[/list]

Jump back in and check out the new features. We’d love your feedback!

notes.title: Reflex Unit: Strike Ops Demo - New Update!
notes.content:
We’re excited to roll out a fresh update for the Reflex Unit: Strike Ops demo, with some new features and enhancements:

[list]
[*][b]Co-Op Campaign Demo:[/b] The Campaign Demo stage is now available in Single Player or online co-op with up to 3 players. Team up and take on the challenge together!
[*][b]Helicopter Boost Ability:[/b] Helicopters now come equipped with a rechargeable boost, giving you improved maneuverability and more tactical flexibility during combat.
[*][b]Customizable UI Scaling:[/b] You can now adjust the User Interface size to better suit your screen and display setup.
[/list]
Jump back in and check out the new features—we’d love your feedback!

[previewyoutube=VnqNL5Amq8M;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who tried out the Strike Ops [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3186100/Reflex_Unit__Strike_Ops_Demo/]Demo [/url]during Steam Fest! The demo is still available, so if you missed it, no worries – it's here to stay!

Based on your incredible feedback, we’ve made several improvements to enhance the Strike Ops experience:

[b]Building Explosions[/b]
Now, when you take down the evil NEOTECH bases, they explode and crumble with dynamic physics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/6296083b2465fbf56621da41467a32b9f0af70a8.gif[/img]

[b]Tuned Container Carrying[/b]
Carrying containers now incurs a significantly reduced movement penalty, so you can move faster and stay nimble.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/bcfa7589467131c662ca3cde6542379cfe416e22.gif[/img]

[b]Increased Enemy Presence[/b]
The NEOTECH forces received reinforcements and a software update to enhance their area control – expect more action in the AO!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/e07805521f16f6e15a8db104d8f54db7009a82f3.gif[/img]

[b]Remappable Controls[/b]
Customize your controls! Gamepad and Keyboard/Mouse layouts can now be configured to match your play style in the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/3ccb044508cfdbdb0bae3a3300e7caf613c1a464.gif[/img]

[b]Adjustable Camera[/b]
Adjust the Field of View (FOV) of the camera to your preference in the settings for an optimized view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/1d89e08f5577c540bcac655546dd95a3a8b68460.gif[/img]

[b]Disable Pause During Conversations[/b]
There’s now an option to disable auto-pause during conversations, so you can stay immersed in the action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/a103d8419bbcade176c35bd2d54921342b63a254.gif[/img]

[b]Show All Objectives[/b]
You can now display all objectives on the map at once, giving you more flexibility to plan your mission strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/e8e826cfe271f14b472ac170f0df6f82d02ce8f4.gif[/img]

[b]Change Vehicle[/b]
Swap your vehicle at any time by returning to the aircraft carrier – perfect for when you need a fresh approach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/69067ade46f0a696c710c883033481701e6dac6e.gif[/img]

[b]Special Surprise[/b]
At the end of the demo, watch out for a surprise appearance from a new contraption from one of NEOTECH's advanced research facilities…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045167/cfadc7f47fe792465953293e951f1101c474d6af.gif[/img]

Additionally, don’t forget that online co-op is available in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2992700/view/4522268823008022326?l=english]BETA [/url]branch, so invite some friends for some Strike Ops action together!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update
notes.content:
We're thrilled by the feedback you've shared on Reflex Unit: Strike Ops since the demo launch last week!

Thanks to your insights, we're rolling out an updated version of the demo (just in time for Steam Next Fest!) with several key improvements, including:

[list]
[*] Adjustable FOV for a more customizable experience.
[*] Increased enemy variety and presence to amp up the challenge.
[*] Option to disable automatic pausing during communications.
[*] Enhanced Lock function UI for smoother gameplay.
[*] Graphic improvements, including V-Sync enabled by default.
[*] Plus, various other fixes and optimizations.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=vNnf41VfeCw;full][/previewyoutube]

Please keep your feedback coming! We're committed to making Reflex Unit: Strike Ops the best it can be, with the full release planned for early 2025, including online versus and co-op multiplayer!

notes.title: October Demo Update
notes.content:
Hi Pilots!

We were thrilled to receive all your fantastic feedback on last month’s YouTube video of the Demo Preview. Since then, ROBOSARU Games has been working hard to incorporate your suggestions and make the October Demo the best it can be.

We’re excited to share an update: a new 60fps Ultrawide (21:9) capture of the current Demo build captured on a typical desktop gaming GPU (RTX 3090), showcasing some of these improvements.

[previewyoutube=4dDnBtn0uyw;full][/previewyoutube]
The second video is a direct capture of the same demo, this time played on a Steam Deck OLED. Reflex Unit: Strike Ops was developed from day one with this platform in mind, and as you can see in the video, it runs smoothly at 60fps.

[previewyoutube=OEpSywotHF8;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope you enjoy the video updates!
